summary: No-ship: the design leaves a Terraform state-isolation invariant unwitnessed and two known fail-open classes incompletely closed.

facts.relaunchTail: This is a property of the run, not of the repository, so the round's next launch may use another backend (--reviewer claude) — the caller performs that switch as its second launch; this launcher never spawns a second backend itself.

triage: review-gate SKILL.md §§ Triage and Rounds govern. Render EVERY finding as a full table row — `ID | Finding (title + full body) | Severity | file:line | Code | Recommendation | Proposed decision` — never truncated and never inside a dialog; then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, or decide row by row — and `as proposed` ends the round in that ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision as the first option, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason; echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text, and none if the round was decided by selection alone. Max 2 rounds. Append the decided rows to `docs/reviews/<slug>/decisions.md` under a `### <gate> r<n> (<reviewer>)` heading — one line per row, `<ID> <decision> — <finding title>[; <reason for reject/defer>]`, and an accepted waiver as `WAIVED by user: <reason>` — then COMMIT it with this artifact. That grammar is not decoration: the conductors anchor on `^### <gate> r<n>` and read the waiver line as the pass condition, so a ledger written in any other shape reads back as a gate still owed.

findings.title: The proposed witness never checks the derived Terraform state key
findings.body: The design removes the independent `state-key`, making the action’s root→state-key derivation the sole isolation boundary, but then tests only that callers provide a nonempty root and omit `state-key`. Those assertions all pass if the action later hardcodes, mistypes, or otherwise misderives the key. `terraform init` can still succeed against the wrong existing state, after which plan/apply may manage another root’s resources—the exact failure this change is intended to prevent.
findings.code:
- ⚠️ 약점: `action.yml:15`의 `ROOT: ${{ inputs.root }}`가 유일한 고리가 되는데 **actionlint가 이 줄을
  못 본다**(재현됨). 증인을 다시 설계한다 — 부정 단언과 **같은 셀렉터**에서 파생:
  `yq '.jobs[].steps[] | select(.uses == "./.github/actions/tf-r2-init")'`로 열거해 ⓐ 크기 == 5(바닥값,
  콜사이트 소유) ⓑ `.with` 키 union에 `state-key` 0건 ⓒ 각 스텝의 `.with.root` 비공허.
  `test_telegram-callsites.bats:63-70`의 **부분 실명 대책**(yq 매치 수 == `grep -c` 교차검증)을 가져온다.
findings.recommendation: Add an action-local witness that proves the backend key is exactly `<validated-root>/prod/terraform.tfstate`, and validate `root` against the three supported roots. Prefer an executable fixture or extracted derivation helper over checking only callsite shape.

findings.title: The canonical versions syntax does not actually equal Bash `source` semantics
findings.body: The proposed character class permits backslashes. Bash double quotes interpret backslash escapes, while a textual reader returns the raw captured bytes; for example `\\` is decoded by `source`, and a trailing `\"` can satisfy this regex while leaving the shell declaration unterminated. Therefore the stated `text parser == source` invariant is false, allowing existing source consumers and the new reader to observe different configuration values.
findings.code:
- **rc를 3분기가 아니라 2분기로 접는다**: `rc 0` = 정본 1회 선언(stdout = 값, 빈 값 포함) ·
  `rc 1` = 판정 불가(파일·키·형태·중복 전부) + stderr 사유 한 줄. 3-way를 쓰는 콜사이트가 **0곳**이라
  유지 근거가 없다.
- **정본 정규식을 좁힌다**: `^export <KEY>="[^"$\`]*"$`(메타문자 배제) + 같은 규약을 versions.env
  전 13줄에 거는 정적 가드를 **같은 PR에 필수 포함**. 그래야 "텍스트 파서 == source"가 강제가 된다.
findings.recommendation: Either forbid backslashes in the canonical grammar or decode precisely the same escape semantics as Bash. Add a contract test comparing reader output with sourced values for every accepted lexical form, including trailing and doubled backslashes.

findings.title: The permanent ABS guard omits the acknowledged empty-domain failure mode
findings.body: The design correctly observes that recursive directory scans and zero-iteration loops can return an expected absence result without inspecting any target. It patches the six known sites with local setup assertions and positive controls, but the permanent guard only rejects the old `-ne 0` spelling. After conversion, an `-eq 1` directory assertion remains compliant even if its floor or positive control is removed, so the same vacuous green can recur without `[ABS]` firing.
findings.code:
- **디렉토리 피연산자 5곳 + 루프 1곳은 `-eq 1`로 안 닫힌다.** 실측: `grep -r PAT <빈 디렉토리>` =
  **rc 1**이고, `for d in $DISPATCHERS`(`tools/tests/test_mutation-dispatch.bats:52`)는 목록이 비면
  반복 0회라 어떤 rc로도 안 보인다. → `setup()`에 비공허 단언(`test_app-token-sha-ssot.bats:8` 형태)과
  원장이 요구하는 **양성 대조**(`tests/test_dr-drill.bats:161-163` 형태)를 함께 건다.
- **신설 module 0.** `tests/lib/absent.sh`는 세우지 않는다. 재개 조건(ADR-0001/0004 형태):
  바닥값 축이 콜사이트 로컬 정책으로 표현 불가능한 자리가 **3곳 이상 실증되고 동반 변경 이력이 실재할 때**.
- 파일: 전 레인의 `*.bats` ~60개. 테스트: 판정 의미 무변경, 위 재현이 red가 되는 증인 추가.

#### 02 · `[ABS]` 거부 가드 + venue 부채 상환

- 원형(`run grep … ; [ … -ne 0 ]`)을 red로 만든다. **새 가드 파일이 아니라** `scripts/check-bats-style.sh`의
  새 클래스 — 그 가드가 이미 bats 「코드 표면」(intest 상태기계·주석 먼저 순서·`<<<`/`$((` 오인원 제거·
  `detect_run`+READFILES·명시-파일 픽스처 모드)을 소유한다. 표면 판정을 둘로 가르지 않는다(ADR-0006 축).
- **하드제로가 아니라 `ABS_BASELINE` 래칫.** 같은 파일의 `BB_BASELINE` 선례(`check-bats-style.sh:23` ·
  `scan-floor.sh:50-51` · `check-bats-accounting.sh:87`)가 정확히 이 이주를 위한 것이다. 래칫이라
  01과 별 PR이 가능하다.
findings.recommendation: Make operand non-vacuity part of an enforceable interface: use a helper that validates target cardinality before absence checks, or extend the guard/accounting model to require a machine-detectable floor and positive witness for recursive or loop-driven scans.
